Definition: from the alternate of G4095; a drinking (the act), i.e. (concretely) a draught:--drink.
BiblicalUsage: Posis is a drink, the act of drinking itself. Jesus says his blood is drink indeed, and Paul says the kingdom of God is not meat and drink but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Ghost.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the kingdom is not measured by what we eat or drink, but by the righteousness that food and drink can never give.
